pages.name: Leshen
pages.text: Леший — Leshen. An ancient forest keeper with a beast skull and a body of timber.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Natural spawning is not configured in this version. Use its spawn egg or summon command.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Claws, a warned directional root strike and up to four wolves. Roots immobilize for 30 ticks, while attacks remain available. Below 40 percent health its attacks accelerate.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: Relict elixir: +25 percent. Relict oil: +15 percent for 40 successful hits.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Forest essence, ancient heart and trophy head. The trophy requires a player or tamed ally’s killing blow.

pages.title: Hunter’s advice
pages.text: Move during the root wind-up. Watch the wolves and coat your weapon before battle.

pages.title: Hunting lures
pages.text: $(l:hunting_lures)Hunting lures$(/l) can call this creature. Read the placement, waiting and cooldown rules before setting an offering.
